fleet-survey-service.text: Rex Fleet Survey Service — Fleet pilots, navigators, physicists, engineers and route cartographers who verify existing lanes and cautiously extend usable corridor knowledge. Mature Fleet visual grammar is deep blue, restrained gold and Ion White; survey teams add controlled violet instrument accents without replacing Fleet heraldry.

aurin-traffic.text: Aurin Rift civilian traffic — miners, haulers and service craft operating around mapped asteroid fields. They depend on certified public routes and green beacons, so a premature route designation can turn a survey mistake into civilian risk.
